lines.beaver: 지난주 모임에 못 갔어요. 무슨 활동을 했어요?
lines.beaver_en: I missed last week's meeting. What did you do?
lines.beaver_roman: jinanju moime mot gasseoyo. museun hwaldongeul haesseoyo?
lines.learner: 동화를 썼어요. 작가님이 알려 주시는 대로요.
lines.en: We wrote fairy tales, just as the writer taught us.
lines.roman: donghwareul sseosseoyo. jakganimi allyeo jusineun daeroyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, a writer came? What is it about?
lines.learner: 장난을 치는 아이가 수수께끼를 푸는 이야기예요.
lines.en: It's about a mischievous kid who solves a riddle.
lines.roman: jangnaneul chineun aiga susukkekkireul puneun iyagiyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds fun. Where does the kid play?
lines.en: The kid runs around playing in the forest. We drew pictures too.

lines.beaver_en: Pictures too? Then will you make a picture book?
lines.en: Yes, our group decided to publish a picture book.

lines.beaver_en: Really? When will the book come out?
lines.learner: 원고가 모이는 대로 바로 만들 거예요.
lines.en: We'll make it as soon as the manuscripts are collected.
lines.roman: wongoga moineun daero baro mandeul geoyeyo.

lines.learner: 네, 시인이 꿈이에요. 계획대로 매주 시를 써요.
lines.en: Yes, I dream of being a poet. I write a poem every week as planned.
lines.roman: ne, siini kkumieyo. gyehoekdaero maeju sireul sseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Amazing. Does the group do other activities?
lines.learner: 가끔 책 전시회에 가요. 동화책도 많이 봐요.
lines.en: Sometimes we go to book fairs. We read lots of storybooks too.
lines.roman: gakkeum chaek jeonsihoee gayo. donghwachaekdo mani bwayo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any hobbies besides writing?
lines.en: I also do flower arranging. It calms my mind.

lines.beaver_en: That's lovely. Do you keep photos of the activities?
lines.learner: 네, 사진첩을 만들었어요. 다음에 보여 드릴게요.
lines.en: Yes, I made a photo album. I'll show you next time.
lines.roman: ne, sajincheobeul mandeureosseoyo. daeume boyeo deurilgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. I'll definitely come to the next meeting.
lines.en: Okay, see you next week then!
